supported_scope.allocations_cardinality: For every natural k and arbitrary list ps of naturals, card(allocations k ps)<=k^ps.length.
supported_scope.soundness: For arbitrary natural list entries, membership implies total product ps.prod.
supported_scope.completeness: If every entry of ps is prime, every function Fin k -> Nat with product ps.prod is in allocations k ps.
supported_scope.factorization_membership: For all natural k, positive n and functions f : Fin k -> Nat, membership in factorizations k n is equivalent to total product n.
supported_scope.factorization_cardinality: For all natural k,n, the defined finite set has cardinality at most k^n.primeFactorsList.length; interpretation using Omega(n) and all multiplicative factorizations requires n>0.
supported_scope.two_residuals: For arbitrary natural n,n',k1,k2,k with k1<=k and k2<=k, the Cartesian product of the two defined finite sets has cardinality at most k^(n.primeFactorsList.length+n'.primeFactorsList.length). Interpretation as all multiplicative recovery pairs requires n,n'>0.
supported_scope.collision_pairs: Ordered unequal pairs in a finite set with equal values under an arbitrary value function are monotone under set inclusion.
supported_scope.endpoint: For a linearly ordered value type and unchanged value function, closed restriction F<=t does not increase the ordered unequal collision-pair cardinality.

exact_hypotheses.slot_counts: Arbitrary natural k, including zero; no upper bound.
exact_hypotheses.empty_slots: For k=0 the unique empty tuple has product 1, is included when n=1 and excluded when n>1. k^0=1, including 0^0=1.
exact_hypotheses.allocations_sound_and_bound: Arbitrary finite list of naturals; no primality required.
exact_hypotheses.all_multiplicative_factorizations: Residual n is nonzero; coordinates are natural and are consequently positive.
exact_hypotheses.two_all_multiplicative_recovery_sets: Both residuals n,n' are nonzero, and k1<=k, k2<=k.
exact_hypotheses.repeated_primes: Occurrences and slots are labeled; duplicate resulting coordinate-product tuples collapse in finite-set images. No squarefreeness or coprimality assumption.
exact_hypotheses.collision_pairs: Finite tuple set, decidable equality on tuple and value types, arbitrary value function; pairs ordered and distinct.
exact_hypotheses.endpoint_restriction: Linearly ordered value type and closed F<=t restriction, with the same F and ambient finite set.
